pr_title: Fix all fragments not loading when one is badly formed
pr_body:
Adds try-catch blocks to the parts where we layer a fragment onto a profile and create a new profile from a fragment. This allows us to continue looping over the remaining fragments after failing to use a badly-formed one, instead of aborting prematurely.

## PR Checklist
* [x] Closes #10590 

## Validation Steps Performed
Non-badly formed fragments get loaded even if there is a badly formed one somewhere

issue_context.title: [BLOCKING] 1.10 breaks fragment extensions
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version (or Windows build number)

1.10.18x

### Other Software

Julia, Ubuntu Community Preview

### Steps to reproduce

Install any fragment extension-bearing application.

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Actual Behavior

The fragments are not loaded.
comments:
Ah, heck.

@PankajBhojwani Canonical created a fragment that says `"font": "Ubuntu Mono"`. We try to parse it as an object. When it fails, we abort loading **all** fragments.

:tada:This issue was addressed in #10601, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal v1.9.1942.0`.:tada:
